title: The new Windows subsystem for Linux architecture: a deep dive - BRK3068
summary: A Microsoft Build 2019 session in which the WSL team explains the new WSL 2 architecture, which runs a real Linux kernel alongside Windows on a hypervisor. It covers faster file performance, Linux file access from Windows and better application support.
why: HN points to it as the authoritative source for how WSL2 works and why Microsoft rebuilt it.

quote.text: the Build talk where WSL2 was introduced is pretty in-depth and does a great job of talking about the motivation
